title: ControlPlaneMachineFile
description: SPEC §8.3, §4.5: `machine.json` in the bindings directory, the operator's choices for this machine, made once and kept beside the bindings. A key that is absent has not been decided.

telemetry.description: The operator's consent to telemetry for every Claude Code session on this machine, recorded by `ccp init --telemetry on|off`. `on`: init writes the user-level telemetry keys and installs the receiver and the product's board timer. `off`: init writes nothing outside the product and no longer mentions telemetry.

allowance_cmd.description: SPEC §25.1: the shell command that prints the account's usage windows (contracts/allowance.schema.json), read through one shared reader per machine by `ccp tasks claim`, `ccp prompt`, `ccp allowance status --sample` and `ccp allowance session-wake --sample` and `--fire`, for every product on this machine. Absent: no usage is read and nothing bounds spend, and `ccp init`, the session-start check and the board say so. A plane.json `telemetry.allowance_cmd` is the old place, read while this is absent.

allowance_stop_weekly.description: SPEC §25.3: the weekly checkpoint, in percent of the weekly allowance, for every product on this machine: a new claim stops there until the lead records the operator's decision (`ccp allowance continue`). A plane.json `telemetry.allowance_stop_weekly` is the old place, read while this is absent.
